description:
[Scope 1 stationary fuel combustion & biogenic split auditor. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Computes Scope 1 direct emissions from stationary fuel combustion (natural gas Sm3, diesel liters, LPG kg, fuel oil kg, wood pellets kg) ex IPCC 2006/2019 guidelines, separating fossil and biogenic CO2 for CSRD ESRS E1.
Usage: Use this tool to compute fossil and biogenic emissions from corporate heating boilers, power generators, and industrial furnaces.
Returns: JSON object with { fuelType: string, quantityInput: number, netCalorificValueGj: number, emissionFactors: object, calculatedTotals: object, esrsE1Disclosure: object }.

biogenicFractionPercent.description: Percentage of fuel derived from biogenic/renewable sources (e.g. biomethane mix)

fuelQuantity.description: Quantity of fuel consumed in physical units (Sm3 for Gas, Liters for Diesel, Kg for LPG/Oil/Pellets)

name: scope1_stationary_combustion
